We need DBE for C11H14NOCl. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring halogens treat as H). For halogen (Cl) treat as H, so effective H = H + halogen = 14 +1 =15. So DBE = C - (H+X)/2 + N/2 +1 = 11 - 15/2 + 1/2 +1 = 11 -7.5 +0.5 +1 = 5.0. So integer 5.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already know. Might still call retrieve_dbe_formula for completeness. Use tool.
